metadata.name: Drone Rocket Mk II — Contra-Rotating EDF
metadata.description: 1000mm drone rocket. 150mm OD body, 50mm avionics column, annular flow path. Two contra-rotating ducted fans, 4× steerable canards, 4× steerable tail fins, 2-axis gimballed vectoring nozzle. Top annular air intake. Five 200mm printable sections joined at interface rings.
